title: Tosha
content:
ALLY
That's all I have so far.

TOSHA, Ally's mom, pokes her head out the door.

TOSHA
Hey babe. (beat) Who are you talking to?

Ally looks at the now empty spot where Alex was sitting.

ALLY
Myself. Just practicing.

TOSHA
Good. But not much longer. It's late.

She turns to leave.

ALLY
Hey momma... I'm sorry. (beat) I'm trying.

Tosha reaches out and puts her hand on Ally's shoulder.

TOSHA
Honey, you're gonna be okay. Keep telling yourself that.

She kisses her head.

TOSHA (CONT' D)
(fake stern)
Not much longer.

ALLY
Okay

Tosha leaves. Ally turns back to Alex who's back against a different column on the porch.

ALEX
See, it's gonna be okay.

ALLY
Like how things used to be?

ALEX
Better. Promise. (beat) Fist bump?

They reach out almost touching -- then laugh and pull away.
